claims.claim: FQ1 FY2027 evidence shows a semiconductor recovery signal: $1.485B sales, 38% year-over-year growth, inventory improvement, margin recovery, book-to-bill above 1 and PCIe Gen6 design-win momentum.

factors.name: sales recovery
factors.basis: Reported revenue grew materially from a depressed comparison base.

factors.name: inventory normalization
factors.basis: Company reported improving inventory conditions and book-to-bill above 1.

risks.risk: A depressed comparison base can overstate normalized recovery strength; design wins can lag production.

contradictions.claim: Strong year-over-year growth follows a depressed base.
contradictions.resolution: Treat recovery as visible but not proof of normalized cycle strength.

unknowns.unknown: Recovery duration, normalized utilization and design-win production timing remain unknown.

claims.claim: Recovery is realized in current results, but one quarter and design-win momentum are insufficient to prove a normalized cycle.

factors.name: cycle execution
factors.basis: Sales and margin recovery are visible while durability is not yet established.

risks.risk: Semiconductor cyclicality, inventory reaccumulation and debt can weaken recovery conversion.

unknowns.unknown: Deleveraging pace and normalized utilization remain unknown.
